entities.name: Harald
entities.description: An elf warrior from Skemfar on Kaldheim who united the wood elves and shadow elves and became king of the elves.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: The realm of Kaldheim ruled by Harald.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of ten realms where Harald lives.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker and Harald's younger brother.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: An ancient elf god imprisoned in the Jaspera tree who some believe guides Harald.

entities.name: Jaspera tree
entities.description: A tree whose fruit gave Harald a vision of an elven dynasty.

entities.name: Wood elves
entities.description: One of Skemfar's two elf tribes.

entities.name: Shadow elves
entities.description: One of Skemfar's two elf tribes.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A god who disguised himself as Valki, subverted Harald and initiated the Doomskar.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A conflict initiated by Tibalt that opened the Omenpaths.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought the Sword of the Realms to Halvar and killed Varragoth.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: The recipient of the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: A sword delivered to Halvar to end the Doomskar.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: A demon that overtook the elven army and was killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm where Tyvar and Harald met.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: A realm whose army invaded alongside Karfell.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: A realm whose army invaded alongside Immersturm.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: An invasion during which Harald and Tyvar led the defense of Kaldheim.

events.summary: After a Jaspera-fruit vision, Harald unites the wood and shadow elves and proclaims himself king of the elves.
events.quote: Harald proclaimed himself king of the elves, ruler over all

events.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, subverts Harald with lies and prompts him to prepare for war; Tyvar grows suspicious and investigates.
events.quote: subverting him with his lies and prompting him to prepare his army for a war

events.summary: With the Omenpaths open during the Doomskar, Harald marches to invade the other realms.
events.quote: Harald marched with his army to invade the other realms

events.summary: In Bretagard Tyvar explains Tibalt's machinations and Harald decides to fight the invaders and helps Kaya deliver the Sword to Halvar.
events.quote: Harald helped Kaya find Halvar and deliver the Sword.

events.summary: Harald traps Varragoth with summoned snakes, but the demon breaks free and is finally killed by Kaya.
events.quote: The demon was only stopped by Kaya who killed him.

events.summary: Harald and the human Clans of Bretagard agree elves and humans will live in peace until the elves can return to Skemfar.
events.quote: elves and humans must live in peace until the elves would be able to return to Skemfar

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Harald and Tyvar lead the defense of all ten realms of Kaldheim.
events.quote: Harald and his brother led the defense of all ten realms of Kaldheim

relations.quote: His younger brother is the planeswalker Tyvar Kell .

relations.note: king who united both elf tribes
relations.quote: Harald managed to unite both of his plane's elf tribes
